Match.title: Match
Match.description: Represents an online real-time multiplayer match

roomId.description: Unique room code identifying the lobby

challengerId.description: UID of the player hosting the room (X)

challengerName.description: Display name of the hosting player

opponentId.description: UID of the joined player (O), or empty string if empty

opponentName.description: Display name of the joined player, or empty string if empty

boardState.description: The 3x3 board representation, containing strings 'X', 'O' or null/empty

skin.description: The cosmetic skin applied to the board

updatedAt.description: When the last move or state update occurred

/matches/{matchId}.description: Houses active game matches indexed by their room codes/ID
